pages.title: Dashboard tester
pages.one: Once a day it opens every page, without clicking, and reports what is broken.

steps.text: You set it up and press Allow this script
Every morning at 06:30 it opens every page
steps.detail: At three widths: laptop, big screen, phone.

steps.text: Looks for errors, slow pages, cut-off layouts, wrong words
Already known on an open ticket?

branch.then: A problem report, at most 3 a day

good: A helper cannot start it; only your daily repeat can.

cmds: pictures of a page, no keychain window
